## Rule

**(decoded 2026-06-07 from ARC-GEN `task_239be575.py` — generator read, not guessed)**
Input: 5-8 x 5-8 grid, colors {0,2,8}: two non-overlapping/non-touching 2x2 red(2) boxes +
cyan(8) noise at density 0.4 (boxes overwrite cyan). Output **1x1**: cyan(8) if a
**4-connected path through nonzero cells** (cyan OR red — paths may cross red) joins
box0 to box1, else black(0).

**Generator invariant (line 69)**: resamples until `path_exists(4conn) == path_exists(8conn)`
— so on ALL generated/hidden data, 4-conn and 8-conn agree (corpus-verified 0 diffs / 200k).
An 8-conn flood (3x3 MaxPool dilate) is therefore exact on-distribution and needs fewer
steps (max k8-need over 200k = 12 vs k4-need = 18).

**LIVE** (`task048_symbolic_8_path_connectivity`, 8,831): 12-step 4-conn F32 Conv/Greater/Where
flood from the first red cell (row-major ArgMax), `connected = count(reach & twos) > 4`,
Gather from a [2,10,1,1] bank + Pad. **LIVE truth = 199,916/200k (84 misses = the k4-need
13..18 tail) => AMBIGUOUS/FILTERED-CLEAN class** (§CLASS-CHECK; real-gate verified).

## Algorithm sketch

```python
g = pad_to_8x8(grid)                      # grids never exceed 8x8 (corpus-certified)
twos, passable = g == 2, g > 0
reach = first_box_2x2_rowbytes            # v8 seeds both cells in both rows of box A
for _ in range(K):                        # K = 5 for current full-box class-bet
    reach = dilate8(reach) & passable     # row-byte lanes, shifts/Ors; 72 B/masked round
out = 8 if reach & last_box_2x2 else 0    # v8 tests both rows and both columns of box B
```

## Don't-do log

- **fp16_selective / blanket f16**: +50,010 regress (2026-05-20 sweep; Cast wrapper overhead).
- **ReduceSum/ReduceL1/Einsum on u8**: NOT registered on ORT CPU (probed 2026-06-07) — count
  via Cast(F16)+ReduceSum or QLinearConv counter.
- **OneHot with u8 values**: NOT_IMPLEMENTED (probed) — F16/F32 values only, cast after.
- **BitwiseAnd at opset 16**: it's an opset-18 op (model bumped to 18; grader-validated
  class per #67 task205 ship).
- **ArgMax(BOOL)**: rejected (#64) — keep the u8 hop.
- **k < 6 in the pre-v8 single-seed / 2-cell-target formulation**: fails 3 visible arc-gen
  pairs (max official k8-need = 6, measured over all 270) ⇒ VISIBLE-FAIL axiom, certain 0.
  Do not generalize this to the v8 full-box formulation, where k=5 passes.
- **Placer-Conv with bias or with hits-plane input**: bias leaks into the 899 padded cells
  (ch0 fires everywhere); a [10,1,8,8]-kernel placer reading the hits plane fires phantoms at
  shifted windows. Margin must be a SCALAR [1,1,1,1] and W bias-free.
- **4-conn cross kernel not needed**: generator guarantees 4conn==8conn on-distribution
  (line 69 resample loop) — don't pay extra steps for 4-conn fidelity (k4 needs 18 for 100%).
- **Mul instead of Min for masking with non-binary mask**: values escape {0,1} (pool of 2s),
  breaking the final count. Min(pool, mask) is the binary-preserving form.
- **k < 7 with the lastcell decision**: officials max lastcell-need is 7 (vs 6 for the
  count test — reaching *some* other-box cell ≠ reaching *the last* cell). Don't reuse the
  count test's k=6 floor for gather-route builds.
- **TopK for the ≥5 count**: emits a mandatory [1,5] INT64 indices tensor (40 B) and needs
  a 5th-element read — strictly worse than Cast-F16+ReduceSum (132) or the gather route (71).
- **And(eq_r, eq_c) for the seed outer product**: BOOL And then still needs a Cast for
  MaxPool — 144 B vs Equal/Cast/Cast/Mul 96 B. Mul(u8) is the cheaper "and".
- **placer reading the hits PLANE with a [10,1,8,8] kernel**: shifted windows fire phantom
  cells outside (0,0) (partial sums of same-sign taps can't cancel). Scalar margin only.
- **QLinearConv-as-counter** (−61 vs Cast+ReduceSum): parked, not refuted — adds NHWC
  runtime-transpose profile risk for +0.04 LB; profile-gate it if ever built.
- **ArgMax on raw packed bytes for "first red row"**: finds the largest BYTE (rightmost-
  bit-heavy row), not the first nonzero row. Binarize with Min(reds,1) first.
- **"any red of last row" hit-test** (skip the highbit smear): WRONG when the two boxes
  share their row span (last row then contains reds of BOTH boxes — own-box bits trigger
  false connected). The exact-last-cell bit (smear) or an "== lbyte all-reached" test
  (+1 k-need ✗) are the sound options.
- **non-grouped pack-conv W [2,10,1,8]**: 160 params; group=2 halves to 80 for free.
- **single-u64 whole-grid pack**: E/W shifts then need per-row boundary masks inside the
  word (+2 ops/round = 88 B/round) and u64 BitShift support is unverified — row-byte
  lanes are strictly better at width 8.
- **Max(variadic) as a Bitwise-Or substitute**: max(0b01,0b10)=0b10 loses bits. BitwiseOr
  is binary-only; the 4-Or chain is forced.
- **k=5 with the 2-cell box-B test**: 6,051/200k corpus misses and official failures —
  VISIBLE-FAIL for that formulation. v8 fixes this by seeding and testing the whole 2x2 boxes.
- **k=4 with full-box seed/target**: r03 simulation found 266/270 visible; do not stage below
  k=5.
- **"any red of last row" remains wrong even with the 2-cell mask doubled further**: only
  highbit|highbit>>1 is provably box-B; adding more bits re-admits own-box false fires
  when boxes share the row.
- **bmask = lbyte | (lbyte>>1)**: FAILS 13/270 visible (over-broad); not correct when boxes share last row.
- **bmask = lbyte direct**: FAILS 6/270 visible; same problem.
- **whole-first-row seed** (reach0 = reds[first_row] not just lowbit): FAILS 6/270 visible — changes k-need distribution.
- **bmask shortcut bmask = smo3 - (smo3>>1)** = just highbit, NOT bmask; off-by-one (misses highbit>>1 cell).
- **Pad axes with INT32**: ORT rejects `axes_2 INT32[1]=[2]` with "ParseData type mismatch for tensor: axes_2. Expected:int64 Actual:int32" — use INT64 for axes.
- **Skip Sub(hit_f16, c05) → margin, feed hit_f16 directly to output Conv**: fails 84/270 visible (not-connected outputs all-zero, decoded as no-channel-fires rather than ch0 fires); the Sub is required to produce a negative ch0 signal when not-connected.
- **Pad axes saves memory, not params**: pdn/pup/axes are initializers whose bytes DON'T count toward memory (only value_info intermediates count); the saving is in params (element count). -11 params = -11 cost.
- **v8 full-box k5 cost642 is hidden-failed**: local visible/profile/truth were insufficient
  for this class bet. The exact SHA `9791950272084368dc499a9caf1283c4bde835b5c3b64d837769575a96b86e82`
  is parked under team `_hidden_failed`; do not restage it as a candidate.
